name: Shieldshift (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons are most often used as off-hand weapons by those who sometimes need a little more protection. As a swift action a shieldshift weapon can transform into a heavy steel shield with an enhancement bonus equal to that of the shieldshift weapon to both AC and to attack rolls with the shield.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield
